g.text: py-app-sticker-terminal-scan-pas | type sticker | trim 109 x 33.76 mm, bleed 3 mm | status rebuilt
Bron: elf printbestanden (source/print). Referentie = getrouwe vectorweergave; template = officiele tokenkleuren, 3 mm bleed, variabelen als live tekst. Labels staan in aparte groepen.
Bron: TerminalStickers_September2026.pdf p1 (CMYK; bleed box in bron nee). Template: trim 109 x 33.76 mm, bleed 3 mm, totaal 115 x 39.76 mm.
Variabelen: text = Scan hier je pas; card-image = py-atom-illustration-card-pas

Snijcontour: groep cut-contour, spot ThruCut, 1 pt, 0.2 mm binnen de trim. Proposal: the source has only a 0.25 pt hairline as die line, no ThruCut contour. Radius measured on the die line, to be confirmed by the printer.

Text 'Scan hier je pas' (Ubuntu 7.62 mm, 'pas' bold) left, pass card right. The card is a third party branded illustration (Philips Stadion), swap the card group for the pass of the location. The card background is a sampled vector gradient (the source shading is not exported by the vector reader, see py-atom-illustration-card-pas), in the reference as well

as in the template. Sheet TerminalStickers_September2026.pdf (271 x 391 mm, no bleed, no trim marks): a hairline die line (black, 0.25 to 0.74 pt) around each white sticker.
